name: Delivery route → COHERENT: open the PR (open_pr)
description:
The coherent delivery route (design R1/D16, group 5). When the run's three independent delivery signals cohere — verify.result=pass (the clean-room cold proof), review.verdict.0=approved (Quinn's D16 verdict), and openspec.validated present (the OpenSpec oracle) — deliver: force open_pr, which records pr.ref (the terminal of the m0 issue→PR arc). This REPLACES the old check_coherence tool + its two router rules: the roll-up is now RULE CONDITIONS reading the harness-stamped signals DIRECTLY (no Go route-token — check_coherence is deleted, G2).

WHY IT FIRES ON THE RUN (not a loop, unlike the floors/review routes): delivery is TERMINAL — it never repeats, so there is no per-attempt reset problem, and a run-scoped delivery.routed guard is correct. All three signals live on the RUN, so a run-fired rule reads them directly with NO mirror. It fires when verify.result=pass is stamped (the last-to-arrive signal; validated + approved are present earlier). At M0 (single task) the review roll-up is the literal review.verdict.0; the multi-task fan-in (count projected tasks vs approved) is the deferred M1 gated-DAG (R9).

TRIGGER: verify.result eq "pass" (required:false — absent = false, so no premature fire before the cold verify), review.verdict.0 eq "approved" (required:false, defense-in-depth — already true to have reached verify), openspec.validated length_gt 0 (required:true — presence at M0; a revision-match eq lands with semstreams #519's .value form, tripwired), and delivery.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). A verify.result of 'retry' (a transient docker flake) matches neither this nor the blocked route (08b), so a flake never triggers delivery — verify re-runs.

RUN BINDING: run_scope=inherit reads the RUN's bare agent.run anchor (stamped by dev-from-task/01) and binds the open_pr loop to the run.

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe, CRITICAL): on_enter FIRST stamps delivery.routed=$entity.instance on the run, guarded by delivery.routed length_eq 0, BEFORE the publish — open_pr is NOT idempotent (a re-fire opens a duplicate PR), so this marker is load-bearing. Mutually exclusive with the blocked route (08b) on verify.result.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt: SEMDEV — the run's delivery signals cohere: the clean-room verify passed, the change validated, and the task is approved. Open the pull request: call open_pr. The harness records the delivery reference — you supply nothing and claim no outcome. Calling open_pr completes your turn.

metadata.fires_on_run: delivery is terminal (never repeats), so this fires on the RUN with a run-scoped delivery.routed guard — no per-attempt reset, no mirror needed (all three signals are on the run).
metadata.trigger_rationale: verify.result=pass AND review.verdict.0=approved AND openspec.validated present. A 'retry' verify matches neither delivery route (it re-runs). openspec.validated length_gt 0 flips to a revision-match eq when semstreams #519's .value form lands (tripwired).
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the RUN-scoped delivery.routed marker, stamped BEFORE the publish — CRITICAL (open_pr is not idempotent).
metadata.only_sanctioned_open_pr_spawner: this is the ONLY rule that forces open_pr (pinned) — a second would open a duplicate PR.
